card.text: Red supergiant in Taurus, its granulation imaged by the VLT interferometer at two epochs.

sources.label: SIMBAD
sources.quote: * 119 Tau -- Red Supergiant; Spectral type M2Iab-Ib

introduction.text: CE Tauri is a red supergiant 700 times wider than the Sun. The VLT interferometer imaged its surface twice, a month apart, and saw a faint pattern of convection cells.

sources.label: Montargès et al. 2018
sources.quote: reconstruct two reliable images of its H-band photosphere

pionier-2016-11.title: Photosphere, November 2016
pionier-2016-11.summary: The authors' image rebuilt from fringes measured by four telescopes, cast onto a sphere. Colour is infrared brightness.

pionier-2016-12.title: Photosphere, December 2016
pionier-2016-12.summary: The same method one month later; the cell pattern barely changed, and brightness keeps the same colour scale.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of a measured spectrum of the star. No surface picture or edge darkening is measured.
